digest.component_or_area: ticket state model and write paths
propositions: bridge_project (tri-state: absent/empty/key) and repos (string list) are added to ticket state schema, seeded in make_initial_state, and projected by the reducer on CREATE and EDIT events
Create-time arguments --bridge-project and --repos are added to all three write surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) with strict unknown-option rejection in the CLI flag loop
bridge_project is promote-only on the edit path: setting it on an unbound ticket succeeds, but changing it on a ticket that already holds a binding is refused with no state change
repos is freely editable on the edit path and never reaches the tracker
The three bridge_project states (absent for legacy, explicit empty for never-sync, key for sync target) are distinguishable after replay and not confused with pre-feature store behavior
